results.title: Lift screw thrust support on the parked tower
results.passage:
A 9 mm recessed screw head carries the M5 retaining nut with two complete pitches beyond its maximum height. The nut top reaches Z753.1 and the shaft reaches Z754.7. The carriage nut has a 2.00 mm gap to the shoulder at park. The combined 275 part envelopes include the retained heads and shortened mast keys. With a 0.5 mm machining allowance, remaining height is 3.725 mm at ±1 mm wheel-height variation and 0.649 mm at ±2 mm. At ±3 mm the aft mast head exceeds the limit by 2.575 mm. The assumed tire variation needs a receiving bound.

The frozen 68 kg contact sample supplied 325.67 N axially to each screw in a symmetric bridge projection. The exact sleeve model first exceeded 0.005 mm³ of guide interference at 8.4653–8.4656 mm differential motion. A two-axis counterfactual with one 0.30 N·m brake available and its opposite brake open reached that threshold in 1.039 s in the frictionless case and 1.418 s in the low-friction case, either side failed. Halving the time step reproduced 1.039 s. Both brakes open can drop both sides together without crossing this differential threshold. A direct catch after 4 mm of unbraked travel must absorb 1.303 J in the frictionless load case. Arrest

results.title: Fixed-camera leads and both host plugs on the 2025 shop robot
results.passage:
Böllhoff offers RIVKLE family STEP/IGES/ProE for design integration through its eShop. The exact SKU's downloadable as-set geometry and public redistribution rights were unverified. Keep supplier files private if obtained, tag as-formed versus as-delivered, and use a source-linked, independently authored envelope if a public assembly needs one. Check a quote for current regional stock. [Manufacturer CAD access](https://www.boellhoff.com/de-en/services/download-cad-data-fast-easy-and-free-of-charge/)

### Keyed joints between nylon guide sections

The M2 × 10 fastener for these flanges is Accu **SSCF-M2-10-A2**, A2 stainless DIN 912 / ISO 4762. This is fully threaded M2×0.4, length 10 mm measured under the head. The supplier specifies Ø3.62–3.80 mm head, height 1.86–2.00 mm, 1.50 mm hex and 1.00 mm drive depth. A nominal Ø2 cylinder is an outside-thread envelope. A separate key registers the flanges and carries shear. The item sheet gives 30 g/100, or 0.30 g per screw. Length tolerance and stocked lot were not confirmed. [Accu exact screw](https://www.accu.co.uk/metric-cap-head-screws/3794-SSCF-M2-10-A2)

Use the separate Accu **HPW-M2-A2** washer, 2.20–2.34 mm ID, 5 mm nominal OD
